Question: At a dance party a group of boys and girls exchange dances as follows: one boy dances with \(5\) girls, a second boy dances with \(6\) girls, and so on, the last boy dancing with all the girls. If \(b\) represents the number of boys and \(g\) the number of girls, then:

Choices.E:
It is impossible to determine a relation between \(b\) and
\(g\) without knowing \(b+g\)
